title: Introducción y presentaciones
summary:
• Greetings and replies to ¿cómo estás?
• Introducing yourself with llamarse (me llamo, te llamas, se llama)
• Saying nice to meet you, and goodbye
• Tú vs. usted, and titles of respect (Don, Doña, Señor, Señora)
• The Spanish alphabet and spelling your name
• Question words cómo and qué; filler word entonces
• Regional slang: ¡Chévere!, ¡Pura vida!, ¡Fenomenal!
• Class is mostly in Spanish: immersion and conversation first

title: Verbos regulares (-ar/-er/-ir) y vocabulario básico
summary:
• Regular verb conjugation patterns for -ar, -er, -ir verbs, using desear, vender, and vivir as models
• Common -ar verbs: trabajar, comprar, hablar, estudiar, and more
• Common -er verbs: comer, aprender, vender, leer, and more
• Common -ir verbs: vivir, escribir, abrir, asistir, recibir
• Hay = there is / there are
• Question words: por qué, quién, cuánto, cuándo, dónde
• Everyday vocabulary, including opposite pairs: caro/barato, cerca/lejos, fácil/difícil, rápido/despacio, siempre/nunca
• Family, relationship, title, occupation, and description vocabulary
